name: Standing hamstring stretch
description: With one heel forward, hinge at the hips until you feel a stretch behind the thigh.

name: Hip flexor stretch
description: In a lunge, tuck your pelvis and shift forward to open the front of the hip.

name: Child's pose
description: Kneel, sit back on your heels, and reach your arms forward to relax your back.

name: Cat-cow
description: On hands and knees, alternate arching and rounding your back with your breath.

name: Seated spinal twist
description: Sit tall, cross one leg over the other, and gently rotate toward the bent knee.

name: Doorway shoulder stretch
description: Place your forearm on a doorframe and turn your body away to open the chest and shoulder.

name: Figure-four glute stretch
description: Lying down, cross one ankle over the opposite knee and draw that leg toward you.

name: Thoracic rotation
description: On hands and knees, rotate one arm up toward the ceiling and follow it with your eyes.

name: Neck release
description: Gently tilt your head to one side and hold, without forcing it.

name: Standing quad stretch
description: Stand on one leg and gently pull the other heel toward your glutes.

name: Supine knee hug
description: Lie on your back, hug one knee toward your chest, and hold a gentle stretch in your lower back.
